title: Symplectic balls and the symmetric Mahler inequality
description: OpenAI's theorem (2026) that for every origin-symmetric convex body K in R^n, n >= 2, every symplectic ball of capacity c < 4 embeds into int K x int K°, and its consequence, the symmetric Mahler inequality vol(K) vol(K°) >= 4^n/n!. Polar bodies, support functions and strip bodies; one- and two-forms, the Pfaffian and volume preservation, flows and Moser's method; plurisubharmonic potentials and dd^c; a ball of capacity below pi k from a holomorphic zero of order k; a planar conformal map from the arctangent series and a uniform estimate for its horizontal slice integrals; a symplectic realization inside int K x S int K° with S close to pi k/4, rescaling, and polar approximation of general bodies.
